name: Per Me Giulio Terrinoni
dinnerNote: 'X me' tasting menu, 10 courses (5 courses €150; Chef's Table €230)
dinnerNoteIt: Menu degustazione 'X me', 10 portate (5 portate €150; Chef's Table €230)
lunchNote: 5-course 'X me + Piccolo' or 'Think Green' menu, daily (10 courses €200)
lunchNoteIt: Menu 'X me + Piccolo' o 'Think Green', 5 portate, tutti i giorni (10 portate €200)

menus.name: 'X me' tasting menu
menus.note: Ten new dishes for the restaurant's tenth birthday, for the whole table; lunch or dinner; pairing of seven wines €110, or three glasses of great wines €160

menus.name: 'X me + Piccolo' tasting menu
menus.note: Five dishes old and new, for the whole table; lunch or dinner; pairing of five wines €90, or three glasses of great wines €160

menus.name: 'Think Green' vegetarian tasting menu
menus.note: Five seasonal vegetarian dishes, for the whole table; lunch or dinner; pairing of five wines €90

menus.name: Chef's Table menu
menus.note: A free-form menu at a counter facing the kitchen, up to 5 guests, daily at 1pm and 8:30pm; wine and drinks pairing €120

bookingOpens: Online through the booking widget on the restaurant's website (ResDiary), for up to 6 people a table; only the dates and times shown can be booked. If nothing suits, contact the restaurant and it will try to help.
cancellation: A credit card is needed to hold the booking, but nothing is charged when booking. Cancel or change the number of guests by email at least 24 hours ahead; later cancellations or changes cost €140 a person in the dining room, €220 a person at the Chef's Table and the full tasting menu price on public holidays.
groups: Tables of more than 6 are booked by email (perme@giulioterrinoni.it); the chef then sends a set menu for the whole table.
dressCode: Smart casual to elegant. Shorts and flip-flops are not allowed for men.
children: Families with children are welcome at lunch.
